title.narrative: Operational support to ACEAC operational planning meeting and timely support to ISPR

description.narrative: The Great Lakes region is still suffering the consequences of violence particularly in Rwanda, Burundi and in the Eastern DRC which have marked the last decades. Several initiatives have been undertaken by political leaders and international community in the effort to respond the crisis by strengthening political institutions, by supporting humanitarian organizations at national, regional and international level. Ongoing national process of democratization, with the support from UN and the International Community as well as the establishment of regional peace mechanisms, security and cooperation are also underway. ACEAC as the catholic regional body has not stood by idly. In the effort to accomplish the social mission of the church, that of promoting peace and justice, ACEAC has initiated several advocacy and direct activities in the region as a way of contributing to the re-establishment of peace in the region. By launching its interdisciplinary Advanced Master level capacity building Program dedicated to social actors otherwise known as ISPR, ACEAC aims to contribute to constructing the long-broken peace in the sub-region through the promotion, dissemination and rooting of a culture of civic cohesion and harmony among the people of the region. ISPR/ACEAC intends to develop personal, interpersonal and intercommunity attitude of reconciliation through better knowledge on critical challenges underlying the fragile peace context in the region. These include poor governance, lack of accountability in the management of natural resources, poor service delivery, etc by aligning a program that is geared toward strengthening the societal ethics and family harmony, peace education, non-violent communication, etc. Three countries are involved in the ISPR project, DRC, Rwanda and Burundi through ACEAC. The students coming from dioceses, civil society and iNGOs will learn a lot regarding the mobility approach developed to achieve the academic cursus. In addition to the above, this project will as well contribute to the development of the ACEAC’s operational plan that ought to complement the ACEAC strategic plan that was developed in the past year. In the effort to strengthen this sub-regional structure, CAFOD is stepping in to contribute to the institutional support which will certainly improve the deliverables and operational quality of ACEAC.
